messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a chunk of invoices for last week had ~0.8% fewer tokens than the tally service. Looks correlated with antifraud drop counts. anyone else seeing this?
sam: yeah saw the alert from metering-bot. suspected fallout from the new antifraud window (drop events older than 2h).
metering-bot: [alert] antifraud-filter-high-drop-rate service=ingest drop_rate=0.009 window=2h affected_tenants=12
liam: 0.9% sounds small but at scale it's $$$. what's the root cause? are we double-dropping or just delaying events?
maya: logs show the route proxy sometimes replays a late event after the antifraud check runs -> ingest dedupe treats replay as new but antifraud already dropped earlier variant. leads to missing accounting + later reconciliation doesn't pick up because watermark moved.
olivia: are we sure it's the window length? we changed from 6h -> 2h to reduce false positives. maybe replays are taking >2h.
sam: quick numbers: in sample tenant A, 4k tokens dropped by antifraud window, 700 tokens later replayed but not stitched into invoice due to join-window mismatch.
liam: sounds like join-window mismatch between antifraud service and tally-ingest. solution options: increase antifraud window to 6h, or make ingest replay idempotent wrt dropped-event tombstones, or have reconciler re-run with late-joins.
maya: prefer minimizing false positives for fraud, so increasing window would raise FP. idempotency looks safer but might be tricky with current fingerprint scheme.
olivia: can we add a short-lived tombstone stream? antifraud writes tombstone markers for dropped ids for 24h so replayed events can be mapped to dropped cause and forwarded to reconciliation. low risk change and limited retention.
sam: implementation detail: tombstone stream would be an extra kafka topic 'antifraud.tombstones' with key=fingerprint value=drop-reason,timestamp. reconciler can join against it. storage cost tiny.
liam: would need schema and contract in metering ingestor. also need console dashboard to surface dropped-by-antifraud counts per-tenant so support can triage.
maya: +1 to dashboard. we should also add a canary rollout: enable tombstones for 10 tenants and compare invoice deltas over 48h.
olivia: for the canary, suggest tenants with heavy replay patterns not high-fraud risk. I'll prepare tenant list.
sam: PR outline: antifraud: produce tombstone topic + tool to purge >24h, ingestor: join tombstones before dedupe, reconciler: backfill from tombstones. tests: e2e sim where replay arrives 3h post-drop.
liam: include metrics: tombstone_hits, tombstone_misses, invoice_delta_reduction. alert if tombstone_missing_rate > 5% in canary.
maya: can someone spike a local sim? I can run load harness to inject replays at 3h and verify.
olivia: I'll add dashboard panels in Console: per-tenant antifraud_drop_rate, tombstone_hit_rate, invoice_preview_delta.
sam: timeline? canary tomorrow if PR lands today. I'll own antifraud side. liam take ingestor schema. maya run sim. olivia dashboard.
maya: sounds good. created an issue: https://issues.redwood/company/INF-2147 — please link PRs. :thumbsup:
liam: one last note: reconcile job should also tag recovered events so accounting team knows it's a late-join not a genuine chargeback. avoids support tickets.
metering-bot: [info] scheduled job: canary-run INF-2147 starting 2024-07-18T04:00:00Z
sam: thanks team, will post updates in this thread during rollout.
